$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md). URLs are the daily updater's smoke-test videos (scripts/smoke-test.sh), which resolve from Apify, except the subtitles, channel and Twitch clip examples, which were run on the live build on 2026-11-11 (runs marqLqGdbC9lQdxbY, efob5d4RJl64Kg2sP, EafQwW7g4Q6GZJb89) and their links downloaded from outside Apify.

tasks.name: youtube-video-download-link
tasks.title: YouTube video download link: direct MP4 and audio URLs
tasks.description: Paste a YouTube video, Short or playlist link and get its direct media URLs: the best combined MP4, every format with resolution, codec and size, the audio-only stream, thumbnails and the title, length and channel. Links are YouTube's own and expire after a few hours, so download soon after the run.
tasks.seoTitle: YouTube Video Download Link - Direct MP4 and Audio
tasks.seoDescription: Get a YouTube video's direct MP4 and audio URLs with every format, resolution and size, plus title, length and thumbnails. Videos, Shorts, playlists.

tasks.name: vimeo-video-download-link
tasks.title: Vimeo video download link: direct MP4 URLs, no login
tasks.description: Get the direct MP4 URLs of a public Vimeo video in every resolution, with title, length and thumbnail, without a Vimeo account. vimeo.com and player.vimeo.com links both work, unlisted ones too when the link carries their hash.
tasks.seoTitle: Vimeo Video Download Link - Direct MP4, No Login
tasks.seoDescription: Direct MP4 URLs of a public Vimeo video in every resolution, with title, length and thumbnail. No Vimeo account needed; unlisted links work too.

tasks.name: soundcloud-to-mp3-link
tasks.title: SoundCloud track link: direct audio URL and metadata
tasks.description: Paste SoundCloud track links and get each track's direct audio stream URL with format and bitrate, plus title, artist, length and artwork. Works for any of 1,000+ sites yt-dlp supports, Dailymotion, Twitch clips and Bandcamp among them.
tasks.seoTitle: SoundCloud Track Link - Direct Audio URL and Info
tasks.seoDescription: Direct audio URLs of SoundCloud tracks with format, bitrate, title, artist and artwork, and media links from 1,000+ other sites yt-dlp supports.

tasks.name: youtube-subtitles-download
tasks.title: YouTube subtitles download: caption URLs in every language
tasks.description: Paste a YouTube video link and get a direct URL for every subtitle track it has, in SRT, VTT, TTML and JSON, plus the auto-generated captions, with the title, channel and length. The example, a TED talk, has subtitles in 49 languages. Links are YouTube's own and expire after a few hours, so download soon after the run.
tasks.seoTitle: YouTube Subtitles Download - SRT and VTT in Every Language
tasks.seoDescription: Get every subtitle track of a YouTube video as SRT, VTT, TTML or JSON URLs, auto captions included, with title and channel. No login, no API key.

tasks.name: youtube-channel-video-links
tasks.title: YouTube channel video links: the latest videos of any channel
tasks.description: Paste a YouTube channel's videos page and get its newest uploads, each with the title, length, view count, upload date and a direct media URL. Set how many videos to take; the example takes NASA's 5 newest. Links are YouTube's own and expire after a few hours, so download soon after the run.
tasks.seoTitle: YouTube Channel Video Links - Latest Uploads of Any Channel
tasks.seoDescription: List a YouTube channel's newest videos with title, length, views and a direct media URL for each. Set how many to take. No login, no API key.

tasks.name: twitch-clip-download-link
tasks.title: Twitch clip download link: direct MP4 in every quality
tasks.description: Paste a Twitch clip link and get its direct MP4 URL in every quality Twitch serves, up to 1080p, with the title, uploader, length and thumbnail. No Twitch login needed. The example is a clip from EA Play 2016. Links are Twitch's own, so download soon after the run.
tasks.seoTitle: Twitch Clip Download Link - Direct MP4 up to 1080p
tasks.seoDescription: Get a Twitch clip's direct MP4 URL in every quality up to 1080p, with title, uploader, length and thumbnail. No Twitch login, no API key.
